metadata.title: Viet Nam ports, dams and reservoirs (OpenStreetMap)

selection.port: landuse=port | harbour=yes | seamark:type=harbour (node, way, area) -> representative point
selection.dam: waterway=dam (node, way, area) -> representative point; crest length for open ways
selection.reservoir: natural=water + water=reservoir areas >= 1.0 km2 -> polygon (simplified 0.0002 deg)
selection.excluded: landuse=reservoir legacy tagging (counted in the report only)

metadata.provinceAssignment: point-in-polygon of the representative point against vnm-adm1-34 and vnm-adm1-63; null when offshore
metadata.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; extract: Geofabrik vietnam-260921.osm.pbf (2026-09-21)
metadata.accuracyNotice: OpenStreetMap is volunteer-mapped: coverage, tagging and names vary by area and date. Geometry is shown for orientation, not for engineering or cadastral use.
metadata.crs: OGC:CRS84 (longitude, latitude; equivalent datum to EPSG:4326)
